source_request: 가로 비율 전쟁터 배경으로 프롬프트 작성하고 그려줘.
interpreted_intent: Continue the established Republic of Korea special-warfare campaign portrait with the same adult woman and camera-directed carbine aim, changing the canvas to a wide landscape ratio and replacing the training compound with a visibly war-torn battlefield.
subject: The same unmistakably adult woman from the original reference portrait, equipped as a modern Republic of Korea special-warfare operator.
setting: An active war-torn battlefield with fractured concrete defenses, churned wet earth, smoke columns, embers, and distant firelight.
event: The upper-body operator shoulders and steadily aims a compact carbine straight toward the camera while the battlefield remains visible beside and behind her.
visual_priorities: A true wide 16:9 landscape canvas rather than a portrait crop
A readable war-torn battlefield extending across the open side of the frame
Preserved adult facial appearance above a convincing head-on carbine axis
baseline_prompt_en: Create a wide 16:9 landscape frame as a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces special-warfare campaign poster featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the original reference portrait. Preserve her long oval face, eye aperture and spacing, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, and long dark wavy hair. The wide 16:9 landscape frame shows her upper body from mid-torso upward, positioned slightly right of center so the battlefield remains visible across the left and center distance. She shoulders a compact carbine and aims it straight toward the camera; both gloved hands control the weapon, the circular bore and optic form a strong foreground-to-face depth axis, and her focused face remains legible above the sight. The camera stays aligned just below her eye line. Behind her, fractured concrete barriers, churned earth, smoke columns, scattered embers, and distant firelight establish an active war-torn battlefield. Rain beads across her matte helmet, headset, uniform, plate carrier, and Republic of Korea flag patch. Cool storm daylight and restrained orange firelight bind operator and terrain into premium national-defense campaign key art: resolute, controlled, battle-ready, and decisive.
